title: Fix TLSRoute router name collision across listeners sharing an entry point
body:
### What does this PR do?

Fixes the TLSRoute router name collision when a TLSRoute attaches to several TLS listeners sharing an entry point.

### Motivation

These routers were given the same name, so only one of them was kept: traffic for the other listener hostnames was rejected, while the route was reported as `Accepted`.

### More

- [x] Added/updated tests
- [x] Added/updated documentation

### Additional Notes
